unspecified.behavior: After a successful unlock or setup completion, the `finally` block re-enables the submit button while the full page load is still in flight.

scores.reason: Only a second click during the brief reload triggers it; that click re-POSTs unlock or complete-setup, and the user still lands on the target page.

After a successful unlock (unlock/page.tsx:42-44) or complete-setup (CompleteStep.tsx:61-63), the button becomes clickable again during the short window before the browser navigates; on a home LAN the user would rarely see or click it, and a second click at most sends a redundant request or flashes an error before the page load.
